status: Read-only structural inspection, not a disposition policy or deletion executor
confirmedMissing: Reviewed tenant data-disposition execution, including lawful retention, app-copy cleanup and restore-deletion enforcement. Cancellation/read-only transition and legal-hold release are not erasure.
implementationConstraints: Preserve active legal holds and mandatory record retention.
Never disable immutable protections or use a raw bulk-delete bypass.
Preserve other academies and shared identity/security records.
Provider originals remain copy-only; clearing a metadata link is not proof of deleting bytes.
Use exact owner-reviewed disposition manifests and durable evidence; do not imply that approval alone executed deletion.
A restored old backup must not silently republish disposed data.
researchBoundaries: A blanket six-year timer is insufficient: CRA lists exceptions including some indefinite historical records,late returns and unresolved objections/appeals.
Ontario employment record periods differ by record category; overlapping obligations need evaluation.
Privacy retention must remain purpose-based; these sources do not certify a particular school-wide purge plan.
